si_disclosure: OpenAI Codex assisted implementation and documentation. Original NASA source values and carried-forward satellite evidence retain their provenance.

method.fit: OLS on calendar-weighted annual data. Bartlett HAC with finite-sample correction and Student t reference.
method.multiple_testing: Holm across 15 cells × 2 variables at lag 3. Lags 1 and 5 each use their own 30-test diagnostic correction.
method.coverage: A year requires 12 usable months. The inherited fit requires at least 20 consecutive annual values. Failed fits enter Holm as p=1 and receive no verdict.
method.scope: Exploratory results for one product and fixed window. Slope intervals are marginal. Separate cell tests do not test a difference between cells.

event.interpretation: Fixed threshold, one radar pair. The recount verifies run arithmetic. Candidate overlap with mapped assets does not establish damage or closure. Independent event accuracy remains unestablished.
